verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains extensive product/feature documentation but no mention of pricing tiers, subscription costs, free vs paid limits, or usage quotas (beyond one word-count/file-size limit unrelated to pricing plans). No pricing page, plan comparison, or cost breakdown is cited anywhere. missing for 10: pricing tiers/plans, cost details, free-tier vs paid usage limits, quota documentation, any comparison page a researcher could use to evaluate cost before committing.
